caseName: Menegus v. E. I. du Pont de Nemours & Co.
caseNameFull: Menegus v. E. I. du Pont de Nemours & Co.

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. N. J. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
